name: Fruit And Nut Energy Bar
ingredients_raw: Dry Fruits (37%) (Golden Raisins, Black Currants, Dates, Cranberries), Cereals (29%) (Rice Crispies, Rolled Oats), Glucose Syrup, Dry Nuts (18%) (Almond and Cashew), Honey, Flax Seeds, Edible Vegetable Fat, Emulsifier (INS 322 from Soy), Humectant (INS 422), Vegetable Gum(INS 415), Natural Flavouring Substances(Cranberry).
